business.about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

promises.opening: good evening, everyone. Welcome to Asian Paints’ Q2 FY27 Investor Call. I am Lakshya Sharma from the Investor Relations team, and it's my pleasure to welcome you all. We're joined today by senior members of our management team, including our MD and CEO, Mr. Amit Syngle; our CFO and Company Secretary, Mr. R J Jeyamurugan; and our AVP Finance, Mr. Parag Rane. I would now like to invite our MD and CEO for his opening remarks. Over to you, sir. Amit Syngle: Hello, and good evening. Welcome to the Q2 FY27 Investor Conference. Great to really be speaking to you once again. So, the core value at Asian Paints has always been delivering joy since 1942, and here we exist to beautify, transform, and preserve all spaces and objects bringing happiness to the world. This is something which we have been pursuing, and that is something which we stay committed to. 3 | This is a disclaimer in the context of what we are talking of today. Getting into the overall areas, in terms of what we have looked at from the point of view of the overall year, and specifically from Q2. These are the six areas which we have spoken of as a strategic intent what we have been driving. 4 | First of all, today Asian Paints as a brand, has something which has built a very strong overall perception in terms of where we are and what we stand for and that is something which is, as an area which we wanted to continue really building on, and therefore building the brand is something which we are looking at. All forms of media, whether digital, whether it is above the line, or whether it is unique integrations, from the point of view of programming. We look at all forms to take this ahead. The other area is the whole area of innovation, and this is something which we stand committed to, so that we are able to differentiate ourselves from a point of view of technology and premiumization as a larger objective of what we can take. Then there is another differentiated piece which comes in, which is the whole area of services which we want to build in, and that is something which we feel that as we go into future, the services piece will become extremely important as a differentiated offering and also as a source to really reach directly to the consumer. The fourth area which we have spoken of is the whole area of regionalization, and we think that today this is a very unique place where we are looking at the identity of a region and galvanizing our strategies more from a point of view of a regional context in terms of where we see ourselves going. The other area is about looking at whole B2B space, and we feel very strongly, given the urbanization and the industrialization which is taking place, the whole investment in terms of infrastructure which is going on, this space becomes more relevant and more meaningful for us as we go forward. The last area also which I am going to talk about is very relevant and something which is a zone which possibly, Asian Paints has taken the first step in terms of taking it, is the area of backward integration. So that possibly we can look at what it can do for us from a point of view of innovation, at the same time how it can look at basically propping up the overall area of creating a huge margin pool for us to really keep on investing in the market as we go ahead. These are six areas which are very important in terms of what we speak of. And as I 5 | spoke of saying that today we are looking at this whole area of integrations very strongly. This is a new world that we are approaching very clearly. As a part of this, we have tied up with five Bigg Boss formats which are across the five regional markets, giving impetus to the regional stories we can tell and how we can connect to the diversity of the people who come. Today, real-time shows are becoming a reality and, therefore, whether it is Bangla, Malayalam, Telugu, Kannada, or Tamil, we have looked at aligning with all these formats, so that we can reach out to people in its own diversity
